context: Jaheira is present with the party and you overhear a family exchange with one of her children; the scene is meant to give backstory on Jaheira and her offspring and to reveal how the household functions when she’s around. The children are of different ages (and in some cases different apparent ancestries), a point they’ll splinter into more detail if Jaheira isn’t present or after she speaks. Jaheira is visibly nervous about leaving Baldur’s Gate because much of her authority and ability to protect her family depends on the influence she still wields there — a worry that feeds directly into the Timeless Body scroll storyline. One of her daughters also likes to play up a supposed Tethyran noble connection, which the player can either humor or debunk.
